comments.text: I had no idea that it was in Macau that Matteo Ricci and Adam Schall von Bell learnt Chinese in the highest registers of the language. I thought they landed in Peking and the rest was 'learning by doing.' Ironic that it was Portugal that wanted to get rid of all its overseas including Macao and the Chinese were not especially interested in getting involved.  Love the black spoonbills. Very interesting video.
